topic_summary: Analysis of the abortion debate as a contested personhood-boundary kernel. Pro-life and pro-choice positions represent fundamentally different readings of when moral status begins (conception vs. viability vs. birth), each emitting constraints with structurally distinct victim sets. Post-Dobbs fragmentation has moved the interpretive authority to state legislatures, creating a patchwork of competing personhood definitions.

key_entities: National Right to Life (largest pro-life organization, formed 1968)
U.S. Supreme Court (constitutional adjudicator; Roe 1973, Dobbs 2022)
American Civil Liberties Union (pro-choice legal advocacy)
Pregnant person (rights-holder in bodily autonomy framework)
key_tensions: Conception vs. viability vs. birth as personhood threshold (kernel contest)
Fetal right to life vs. maternal bodily autonomy (rights collision)
Federal constitutional protection vs. state legislative authority (post-Dobbs)
Religious natural-law grounding vs. secular autonomy grounding (authority sources)
Biological humanity vs. legal personhood (ontological vs. juridical status)

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The personhood-boundary kernel: when does a developing human organism acquire moral status warranting legal protection?
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Pre-Dobbs: Supreme Court viability standard. Post-Dobbs: state legislatures define personhood thresholds, grounded in competing moral frameworks (religious natural law vs. secular autonomy).

readings.commitment: Moral status begins at conception (fertilization or implantation)
readings.authority_grounding: Religious natural law (Catholic/Orthodox doctrine); biological continuity argument
readings.expected_structural_delta: Fetus enters victim set at conception; abortion becomes homicide-equivalent; high suppression of maternal autonomy claims; state interest in fetal life maximal from conception forward

readings.commitment: Moral status begins at viability (capacity for independent survival, ~24 weeks)
readings.authority_grounding: Roe v. Wade framework; developmental capacity threshold; state interest balancing
readings.expected_structural_delta: Fetus enters victim set at viability; pre-viability abortion permissible under maternal autonomy; post-viability state may restrict; intermediate suppression regime

readings.commitment: Moral status begins at birth (physical separation from maternal body)
readings.authority_grounding: Bodily autonomy framework (Thomson); legal personhood tradition; no enforceable right to use another's body
readings.expected_structural_delta: Fetus never enters victim set pre-birth; pregnant person sole rights-holder; abortion permissible throughout pregnancy; zero suppression of maternal autonomy

axiom_contradictions.basis: Conception reading holds that moral status is intrinsic to biological humanity from fertilization; birth reading holds that moral status requires independence from another's body. No coherent framework can simultaneously hold both that a zygote possesses full moral status and that moral status requires physical separation.

Conception reading holds that moral status is present from fertilization regardless of developmental capacity; viability reading holds that moral status emerges with capacity for independent survival. No coherent framework can hold both that a non-viable embryo has full moral status and that moral status depends on viability.

axes.structural_delta: Fetus acquires full moral status at conception, entering victim set immediately; abortion becomes homicide-equivalent
axes.primary_observable: State laws defining life as beginning at conception; criminal penalties for abortion equated with homicide; no exceptions for rape/incest in strictest regimes
axes.selection_reason: Core reading with highest suppression regime; distinct victim set structure; religious authority grounding

axes.human_readable: Viability Reading (Moral Status at Independent Survival Capacity)
axes.structural_delta: Fetus acquires moral status at viability (~24 weeks); pre-viability abortion permissible, post-viability restrictable
axes.primary_observable: Roe v. Wade framework; state laws permitting pre-viability abortion; gestational limits at viability threshold
axes.selection_reason: Intermediate reading; balancing framework; overturned but historically dominant; distinct from conception and birth readings

axes.human_readable: Birth Reading (Moral Status at Physical Separation)
axes.structural_delta: Fetus never enters victim set pre-birth; pregnant person sole rights-holder; bodily autonomy trumps fetal claims
axes.primary_observable: State laws permitting abortion throughout pregnancy; no gestational limits; Thomson's bodily autonomy argument
axes.selection_reason: Maximal autonomy reading; zero fetal victim set; structurally opposite to conception reading; completes triadic kernel decomposition

axes.structural_delta: Interpretive authority devolved to state legislatures; patchwork of competing personhood definitions across jurisdictions
axes.primary_observable: State-by-state abortion law variation; trigger laws; constitutional amendments; interstate travel for abortion access
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: downstream institutional consequence of kernel contest; captured in omega as jurisdictional fragmentation variable

axes.human_readable: Bodily Autonomy vs. Fetal Rights (Rights Collision Framework)
axes.structural_delta: Even if fetus has right to life, no enforceable right to use another's body without ongoing consent
axes.primary_observable: Thomson's violinist argument; legal precedents on bodily integrity; forced organ donation prohibitions
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: philosophical argument internal to birth reading; not independent axis; covered by birth_reading constraint story

deferred_axes.structural_delta: State-level interpretive authority creates jurisdictional patchwork
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Downstream institutional consequence of kernel contest; jurisdictional fragmentation is omega variable rather than independent constraint axis

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Rights collision framework (no enforceable right to use another's body)
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Philosophical argument internal to birth reading; not structurally independent; covered by birth_reading constraint story

omegas.description: Viability threshold (~24 weeks) is medically contingent on neonatal technology. As NICU capabilities advance, viability moves earlier, potentially collapsing viability reading into conception reading over time. Is viability a stable mountain or a technology-dependent piton?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) + viability_reading structural analysis

omegas.description: Post-Dobbs state-level authority creates 50+ competing personhood definitions. Does this fragmentation stabilize as federalist equilibrium or generate interstate conflict (travel bans, extradition disputes, constitutional crisis)?

Conception reading grounds authority in religious natural law (Catholic/Orthodox doctrine). In secular constitutional framework, is this grounding legitimate or does it violate establishment clause? Unresolved tension between religious moral authority and secular legal authority.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) + commitment_system_recognition authority analysis

omegas.description: Conception reading splits between fertilization (zygote formation) and implantation (8-18 days later). This internal split affects IVF, emergency contraception, and IUD legality. Is conception reading one constraint or two?
omegas.source: Extraction summary + conception_reading internal coherence check

omegas.description: Emerging neuroscience on fetal pain capacity (~20-24 weeks) may create fourth reading grounded in sentience rather than viability or conception. Not yet institutionally dominant but structurally distinct.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) — model operates in legal/philosophical medium, may miss emerging neuroscience axis

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Kernel decomposition into three readings is structurally sound: conception, viability, and birth readings emit distinct victim sets and suppression regimes. Axiom contradictions confirmed between conception/birth and conception/viability pairs. Post-Dobbs fragmentation deferred as downstream institutional consequence rather than independent constraint axis.
